ops.summary: Name, URL, theme, active plugins, content types, taxonomies, menus, SEO plugin, WooCommerce, locale, bridge ceiling and ops.
Bridge version, PHP/WP versions, clock skew and round-trip check.
List posts/pages/custom types (non-published statuses need draft level).

params.status: string|publish (default), draft, pending, future, private, trash, any
params.author: int|Author ID

ops.summary: Read one item with raw content, meta, terms, SEO, template. Drafts need draft level.

params.id: any|Post ID, or slug/path as a string
params.post_type: string|Needed when id is a slug

ops.summary: Create or update a post/page/custom item. Keep status draft/pending at draft level; publish or edit published items needs live.

params.title: string|Title
params.template: string|Page template file or block template slug
params.date: string|Y-m-d H:i:s (site time), schedules when future
params.meta: object|{key: value}; protected keys are refused

ops.summary: Copy an item as a new draft.
Move to trash (recoverable).
Restore from trash.
Delete permanently. Cannot be undone.
List WordPress revisions of an item, or restore one.
Change the status of up to 50 items at once.

params.status: string|publish, draft, pending, private or trash

ops.summary: Read custom fields of a post, user, term or comment (one key or all). Underscore keys and user meta need admin.
Set a custom field on a post, user, term or comment. Returns the previous value.
Delete a custom field. Returns the previous value.
List categories, tags or any taxonomy terms.
Create or update a term.
Delete a term (posts keep existing).
List comments (author email only at admin level).
Approve, hold, spam or trash comments.
Reply to a comment as the connected admin.
Delete comments permanently.
Design tokens: colors, fonts, font sizes, spacing, layout widths (theme.json + site tokens).
Merge design tokens. Emitted as CSS variables (--wpm-*) and, on block themes, merged into Global Styles.
Additional CSS (named sections) as stored.
Write CSS into a named section (replace, append or prepend). Other sections are untouched.
Remove a CSS section.
Block templates and template parts (header, footer…), or classic theme template files.
Read a template or part (raw block markup).

params.slug: string|Template slug, e.g. header, footer, single, front-page

ops.summary: Create or override a template/part (block themes). Revert with design.template_reset.
Drop the custom version, falling back to the theme file.
Menus and theme locations.
One menu as a tree.
Create or replace a menu from a tree and assign locations.
Delete a menu and its items (recoverable with activity.undo).
Static front page / posts page, or latest posts.
Site title, tagline, logo and site icon.
Installed themes and which is active.
Switch the active theme.
Install a theme from WordPress.org by slug.
Install a theme from an https zip URL (GitHub release, your own server; redirects are re-checked).
Delete an installed theme that is not active.
List files of the active (or given) theme.
Read a theme file.
Write a theme file (PHP is syntax-checked; previous content is kept for undo).

params.path: string|Path inside the theme (php, css, js, json, html)

ops.summary: Media library items with URLs, sizes and alt text.
One attachment with all sizes.
Upload a file from base64 data (max 10 MB; bigger: put it in uploads and use media.register).

params.title: string|Title
params.caption: string|Caption
params.featured: bool|With attach_to: make it the featured image
params.optimize: any|true (saved settings) or {max_width, quality 30-100, format webp|jpeg|png|avif|mp4|webm}: shrink and convert while storing

ops.summary: Download an image/file from an https URL (no redirects, no private addresses).
Add files that already lie in wp-content/uploads (copied by FTP/files.write) to the media library: makes sizes, alt text, optional featured image. scan:true finds all unregistered files.

params.scan: bool|Find every file not yet in the library
params.featured: bool|With attach_to: first image becomes the featured image
params.title: string|Title (single file)
params.caption: string|Caption
params.optimize: any|true (saved settings) or {max_width, quality 30-100, format webp|jpeg|png|avif|mp4|webm}: shrink and convert while storing

ops.summary: Shrink and/or convert existing library images (jpeg/png/webp/avif) or videos (ffmpeg needed) to save space. Replaces the file for good; links in posts are rewritten.

params.format: string|keep, webp, jpeg, png, avif, mp4, webm
params.fix_links: bool|Rewrite old URLs in post content (default true)

ops.summary: Edit metadata of one item: alt text, title, caption, description, slug.
Delete an attachment and its files permanently.
SEO fields of an item (title, description, canonical, robots, OG, schema), via Yoast/Rank Math/AIOSEO/SEOPress or the built-in fallback.

params.id: any|Post ID, or slug/path as a string

ops.summary: Set SEO fields. Published items need live.
Audit a page of this site: title/description length, headings, alt text, canonical, robots, OG, schema, links, size. Returns scored issues with fixes.
Site-wide SEO: search visibility, robots.txt, sitemap provider, organisation schema, active SEO plugin.
Site-wide SEO (built-in layer): robots.txt text, organisation schema, title separator, default OG image. Search visibility needs admin.

params.blog_public: bool|false hides the whole site from search (admin only)

ops.summary: Sitemap provider, URL and number of URLs; can switch the core sitemap on or off.
Redirects managed by the bridge.
Add or update a redirect.
Remove a redirect.
Custom JSON-LD of an item.
Set custom JSON-LD for an item (empty removes it).

params.json: any|JSON-LD object or array (or a JSON string)

ops.summary: Rendered HTML of a page of this site (same host only, redirects not followed off-site).

params.path: string|Path like /about/ or full URL on this site

ops.summary: Render a post (also drafts) through the_content, without the theme.
Compact structure of a page: headings, landmarks, images, links, forms, meta, scripts, and an element tree (depth-limited).

params.path: string|Path or URL on this site
params.selector: string|Simple selector (#id, .class, tag) to zoom into

ops.summary: Stylesheets used by a page, or the text of one local stylesheet.

params.path: string|Page path to list its stylesheets
params.css_url: string|One local stylesheet URL to read

ops.summary: Site Health tests, versions, SSL, memory, disk, debug flags, cron, pending updates count.
Available core, plugin and theme updates.
Update core, a plugin or a theme (takes a database backup first by default).

params.slug: string|Plugin file (dir/file.php) or theme directory; omit for core

ops.summary: Database backup (gzip SQL) stored outside public listing.
Backups made by the bridge.
Restore a database backup (replaces current data).
Delete a backup.
Tail of debug.log / PHP error log with repeated lines grouped.
Empty debug.log.
Flush object cache, expired transients, rewrite rules and known cache plugins.

params.scope: array|any of: object, transients, rewrite, plugins (default all)

ops.summary: Table sizes, overhead, autoload size, counts of revisions/transients/spam/trash.
Clean revisions, expired transients, spam, trash, auto-drafts, orphan meta.

params.targets: array|revisions, transients, spam, trash, auto_drafts, orphan_meta

ops.summary: OPTIMIZE TABLE on the site tables.
Serialization-safe search and replace across the database. Always preview first.
Download a language pack (core, plugins, themes), e.g. fa_IR, and optionally make it the site language.

params.activate: bool|Also set it as the site language

ops.summary: Read-only SQL: one SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN. {prefix} stands for the table prefix.
One INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE/CREATE/ALTER/DROP/TRUNCATE. Confirmed; not undoable (take maintain.backup_create first).

params.query: string|SQL; {prefix} stands for the table prefix

ops.summary: Scheduled events.
Run a scheduled hook now.
Serve a 503 maintenance page to visitors (admins and the bridge still see the site).
Installed plugins with version, status and update availability.
Search WordPress.org.
Install a plugin from WordPress.org by slug.
Install a plugin from an https zip URL (no redirects, no private addresses).
Activate a plugin.
Deactivate a plugin (the bridge itself cannot be deactivated).
Delete an inactive plugin and its files.
Names of options that belong to a plugin (values hidden; read them with options.get).
Public authors: ID, name, slug, post count.
Users with roles (emails included).
One user, by ID, login or email.
Create a user and send the standard set-password email.
Update name, email or role (role changes are confirmed).
Delete a user, reassigning content.
Send a password-reset email to a user.
Roles and their capabilities.
Read options. Safe keys at read level, everything else at admin; keys that look like secrets are never returned.
Names of readable options, optionally by prefix.
Write options. Safe keys (title, tagline, permalinks, reading…) at live, others at admin (confirmed); secrets are refused.
Delete an option.
REST namespaces and routes (with methods) so you can reach any plugin.
Call any REST route internally as the connected admin. Level depends on method and route: public content GET = read, sensitive routes and unknown namespaces = admin, DELETE needs confirmation.
Is WooCommerce active: version, currency, product/order counts, pages.
Products (published only at read level).
One product with prices, stock, attributes, variations summary.
Create or update a simple/variable product (publishing needs live).
Delete a product permanently.
Set stock or price of products quickly.
List discount coupons.
Create or update a coupon.
Orders (customer data included).
One order with billing and shipping details.
Change order status or add a note.
Payment gateways (Zarinpal, bank transfer, COD…): enabled state and non-secret settings.
Turn a payment gateway on/off and edit non-secret settings (keys and merchant codes are entered by the owner in WooCommerce).
Shipping zones with locations and methods.
Forms from Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, WPForms or Fluent Forms.
Form definition (fields and mail settings, without secrets).
Create or update a Contact Form 7 form (other providers: use rest.call).
Submitted entries (personal data).
List files under a root (root "themes" or "plugins" lists folders): core (WordPress folder, read-only except .htaccess and robots.txt), themes/<slug>, plugins/<slug>, mu-plugins, uploads[/sub].
Read a file: text as text, other types as base64 (2 MB max).

Create or replace a file; missing theme/plugin/mu-plugins folders are created. Text types in themes/plugins/mu-plugins, media types in uploads. PHP is syntax-checked and the front page probed; previous content is kept for undo.
Write up to 60 files into one root in one call (a theme or plugin skeleton). New themes/<slug>, plugins/<slug>, mu-plugins and uploads folders are created. Each file is undoable.
Create a folder inside a root (themes/<slug>, plugins/<slug>, mu-plugins, uploads).
Delete a folder and everything in it. Not undoable.
Move or rename a file inside a root (2 MB max, undoable).
Copy a file inside a root (2 MB max).
Download an https file (font, image, script; 20 MB max) straight into a root. Redirects are re-checked.
Download a zip and extract it into a root (whole theme or plugin, assets). Known text/media types only; existing files are replaced; not syntax-checked.
Delete a file permanently.
Export a page of content as portable JSON: posts (with meta, terms, SEO, builder data), terms, menus, media index or design settings.

params.kind: enum:posts,terms,menus,media,design,users,options|What to export (users and options need admin)
params.status: string|publish (default); other statuses need draft level
params.prefixes: array|For kind options: option name prefixes, e.g. ["woocommerce_"]

ops.summary: Import items made by transfer.export. Creates drafts by default and skips slugs that already exist.

params.kind: enum:posts,terms,menus,media,design,users,options|What is imported (users and options need admin and confirmation)
params.source_url: string|Home URL of the source site (its links are rewritten and its uploads fetched over https)
params.publish: bool|Keep the source status instead of draft (live level)

ops.summary: What the bridge did on this site: operation, who, when, result, revision ID.
Undoable changes with before/after summary.
Revert a change by revision ID (needs at least the level of the original change). Permanent deletions cannot be undone.
